correctness.rationale: Exact Hermitian block matrix and one-site non-Hermitian loss specified for every N>=2. The finite-dimensional dissipativity proof establishes that capture is the H-cyclic projection. T=B*B is an explicit Jacobi matrix with one zero-visible eigenspace at all flux. For generic phase the singular values are all simple and a two-adjacent-component cancellation is impossible over the reals due to the nonzero phase. Zero flux produces an explicit cosine eigenvector and exactly gcd(j,N+1)-1 invisible positive modes by sine divisibility. Half flux makes T diagonal and gives precisely one or two visible singular magnitudes depending on endpoint versus interior. The 140 cases of independent Krylov/spectral rank agreement plus 3 long-time loss exponentials corroborate these steps; neither finite check is treated as proof for every N.

value.rationale: Exact site-resolved infinite-time absorption in an experimentally motivated magnetic rhombic lattice is a nontrivial natural observable. Three fundamentally distinct flux regimes are classified uniformly in chain length. The zero-flux gcd(j,N+1) selection rule is a genuinely arithmetic characterization of optimal and obstructed detector placements; half-flux caging produces an exact interior versus end distinction. Generic-flux transport and special-flux trapping can be compared without numerical time evolution, a concrete structural quantum-network result. Finite-time robustness and disordered variants are not claimed.
